result.summary: Found 3 visual issues: one content error, one layout overlap, and minor clipping in horizontal carousels.

issues.description: The discount badge on the lower restaurant card shows “-0%”, which looks like an invalid or placeholder promotion value.
issues.suggestion: Hide the badge when the discount is 0%, or display a meaningful promotion such as “€0 delivery” or “10% off”.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar overlaps the restaurant content; the lower card image is partially hidden behind it.
issues.suggestion: Add enough bottom padding/safe-area inset to the scrollable content so cards can sit fully above the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: Some horizontally scrollable items are awkwardly clipped at the right edge, including a blank partial category pill and the third restaurant in “Fastest near you”.
issues.suggestion: Adjust carousel spacing or snapping so partially visible items still look intentional, or show a clearer scroll affordance.
